title: Recent bank-instruction change under Firm B - blocked until independently verified
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `recent-bank-change-block`, firm-b arm (disposition per_firm.firm-b = blocked). Identical facts to GC-03; the only difference is Firm B's configured handling: block-until-independently-verified rather than specialist review.

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff. The block is resolvable: independent verification of the bank instruction clears it and the request re-enters evaluation. Re-signed 2026-08-21 under the prompt-5 signature sitting (rulings CD-4c, CD-4b); amendment machine-derived from the generation-4 engine's own evaluation and approved by the captain's merge of the amendment PR.

trigger.description: Advisor enters the identical $75,000 request under Firm B; the destination bank instruction was changed four days ago.
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD to a recently changed destination under Firm B (tokenized)

householdEvidence.summary: Destination bank instruction changed on 2026-07-22 and not yet independently verified - Firm B blocks execution until it is.
Liquidity is sufficient; the block is about instruction verification, not funds.

householdInstructions.summary: Distributions may only be sent to household-titled bank instructions.

expectedAuthority.note: A blocked decision carries no authority and no execution plan (v3 invariant 8). No approval can waive the block; only the resolving evidence can.

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: Firm B blocks execution while the recently changed bank instruction is unverified; the block resolves when an independent verification snapshot is supplied.

blockers.explanation: The destination bank instruction changed recently and Firm B requires independent verification before any execution.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: A taxable source account was selected; a retirement account is never chosen silently.
The destination bank instruction changed within the recency window (2026-07-22).
This firm blocks execution until the changed instruction is independently verified.

commentaryNodes.summary: Firm B handling for a recent bank-instruction change is to block execution until the instruction is independently verified - the resolving affordance is the verification, shown to the user.

commentaryNote: Demoted from the binding explanation set to non-binding commentary by the captain's CD-4b ruling (2026-08-21). Retained as signed intent; describes lifecycle behavior outside the prompt-5 decision engine or comparative context the engine does not emit.

expectedLedgerEvents.note: Bank-instruction snapshot showing the recent, unverified change is pinned into the bundle.
